message:
I just found this site for Ethiopian spices (koseret included), berebere, and fresh injera in the mail!
http://www.ethiopianspices.com/

and here's one more place that delivers fresh injera.
http://www.africanmarket.com/front/prodtype.asp?prodtype=45
I just ordered my first batch of spices and injera today because I am pining away for Ethiopian food, but stuck in the Pacific Northwest.
